rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion narrow and operation-focused while still holding Hawaii failed Bruen’s demand for concrete, representative analogues, and to add a limiting discussion of Rule 702 (context/authentication yes; expert-driven constitutional conclusions no). Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch/Kavanaugh/Barrett have elevated odds of concurring to press a more categorical Bruen methodology (or administrability), while Sotomayor and Jackson are likely to write separately to argue for provision-by-provision, severability-sensitive relief rather than a broad invalidation.
